name: Historical wards 1, 2, 3, 4 and 10 of former Đà Lạt city

source.title: 3rd Level Administrative Boundaries Vietnam
source.datasetDescription: This polygon shapefile contains the third-level administrative divisions of Vietnam (adm3). Level 3 divisions include communes, rural communes, and wards. This layer is part of the Global Administrative Areas 2015 (v2.8) dataset.
